title: Virtual Dynamic Labs
tagline: A web3 based clubhouse like platform for people to social with text, audio
description: A web3-based clubhouse-like platform for people to socialize with text and audio. Participants can earn token rewards by providing interesting content that attracts new users. Any users who stayed on the platform also earn tokens rewards by actively participating in community contribution.
how_its_made:
We used XMTP as messaging protocol. This is a wonderful tech that allows users to send messages to a certain wallet address. For blockchain connection or interaction, we used Moralis in our project.
Mobile application is developed in react native and compatible to both IOS and Android.
